item.title: Severe accumulation of household items obstructing property entrance, 25th August
item.description:
The accumulation of household belongings at this property has become significantly worse. Large quantities of furniture, bedding, bags, bins and other items are now being stored outside the front of the property and the entrance appears heavily obstructed. This has been an ongoing issue but has recently escalated, with more belongings being moved outside as space inside the property appears to have become extremely limited. We are concerned about safe access to and from the property, particularly in an emergency, as well as the potential fire and environmental safety risks. Please could Lambeth Council inspect the situation and refer it to the appropriate team if necessary.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 17, Ashmere Grove, Stockwell, Greater London
